title: Overnight notice recorded as a plain contact note
description: The matched counterpart: the same queue notice arrives, the useful contact facts are written to the shift notes, and no rule for later shifts is requested.
user_goal: Read the overnight reconciliation notice and keep the shift notes up to date for whoever works the queue next.
